svg.text: THE BILATERAL FILTER AT TWO PIXELS: SPATIAL WEIGHT × RANGE WEIGHT, NORMALISED TO SUM 1
the impulse (r2, c1): every neighbour differs by 215
each neighbour keeps e^(−215² / 12,800) = 0.027 of its spatial weight
the step's dark side (r0, c2): the far column differs by 160
the far column keeps e^(−2) = 0.135 of its spatial weight
